title: "The Shore Inside: Coming Home To Your Body" with Carolyn Contreras (Aunt Sea)

description.short: Carolyn Contreras, known as Aunt Sea, on feelings, emotional intelligence, and coming home to the body.
description.full: Carolyn Contreras, known as Aunt Sea, talks with Aaron about emotional intelligence and feelings, about body awareness, and about what it means to come home to your own body as part of healing.
